# Terms of Service

> Proposed contracting party: **[VERIFIED LLC LEGAL NAME]**, doing business as Gold On The Spot only if that trade name is verified. Operating location: New York City. Legal notice address: **[VERIFIED BUSINESS MAILING ADDRESS]**. Website: https://goldonthespot.com. Existing published support contact: support@goldonthespot.com (owner must confirm monitoring). No license, insurance, registration, or corporate formation fact is certified by this draft.

## Scope and parties
These Terms govern use of Gold On The Spot’s website and, when incorporated into an accepted order, the services and purchases described there. “Company,” “we,” and “us” mean the verified contracting entity identified above, not its owners personally. Nothing releases a person from liability the law independently imposes. The website offers physical precious metals for delivery within approved United States destinations. We do not offer investment management, interest-bearing accounts, leveraged metal trading, or guaranteed returns under these Terms.

## Eligibility and accounts
You must be at least 18 and legally capable of contracting, or act with authority for the purchaser you identify. Supply accurate information, use payment methods you are authorized to use, protect credentials, and promptly report suspected account misuse. Do not share verification codes or send passwords, card security codes, or account credentials to support. We may restrict an account reasonably to investigate suspected misuse or comply with law, but restriction does not erase lawful refund or information rights. Identity checks are risk-based; verification is not a guarantee that fraud cannot occur.

## Documents governing a purchase
Before submitting an order you will be able to review the Customer Purchase Agreement, Market Loss and Price Lock Policy, Refund, Return and Cancellation Policy, applicable payment terms, and Shipping Policy. The accepted order’s product, price, quantities, deadline and delivery terms control its commercial particulars. Mandatory law controls all documents. The Purchase Agreement controls formation and purchase remedies; the specific payment policy controls payment mechanics; the Privacy Policy controls descriptions of data handling. No document expands an exclusion beyond what law permits. A discrepancy must be resolved before acceptance rather than by selecting a term unfavorable to the customer after the fact.

Website use alone does not create a purchase contract. Customer submission is an offer, and only the definitive acceptance described in the Purchase Agreement creates the purchase contract. A pending order, payment authorization, payment receipt or tracking page is not that acceptance. No new arbitration agreement applies unless separately approved, conspicuously presented and affirmatively accepted.

## Information and service availability
Prices fluctuate; general market data is indicative. Product-specific fine metal content, gross weight, purity and condition should be read together. We will not knowingly substitute different goods without agreement. We may correct website information prospectively, but an accepted sale cannot be canceled merely because the market moved against us. Reasonable website maintenance and third-party outages may interrupt browsing. Accepted orders remain subject to their obligations and lawful remedies.

## Liability and remedies — proposed allocation
To the extent lawful, neither party owes the other speculative investment profits or indirect or consequential business losses from ordinary website interruptions or breach. This exclusion does not limit refunds, delivery of conforming goods, lawful direct damages, statutory remedies or costs awarded by law. For an ordinary website-only claim unrelated to an order, personal information, personal injury or tangible property, the proposed aggregate limit on the Company’s direct liability is $100. For an ordinary merchandise contract claim, the proposed limit is the affected order’s purchase price plus reasonable direct costs of obtaining the promised performance. These proposed caps require counsel’s approval and do not apply where a limited remedy fails its essential purpose.

No exclusion or cap applies to fraud, intentional misconduct, gross negligence, personal injury, statutory privacy or consumer remedies, or any liability that cannot lawfully be limited. We do not disclaim product authenticity, described weight or purity, title, or warranties that applicable law requires. Nothing limits lawful recovery of the buyer’s price payment obligation or makes disputed default damages automatically payable.

## Changes, law and disputes
New versions apply only to future activity after required notice and assent. Accepted orders retain their archived versions; no retroactive change is imposed by continued browsing. New York law is proposed, subject to controlling federal law and mandatory protections of the customer’s applicable jurisdiction. Contact support with the order reference and desired resolution. Informal discussions do not stop customers from timely exercising payment, court, regulatory or other statutory rights. Unless a separately effective arbitration agreement applies, disputes proceed in a court with lawful jurisdiction; this draft imposes no exclusive distant consumer forum. An invalid provision is limited or severed only as law allows, preserving the remaining lawful bargain. No waiver follows merely from a delay in enforcement.

# Customer Purchase Agreement

> **DRAFT — NOT EFFECTIVE. Prepared October 23, 2026. Version 2026-10-23-draft.1.**
> Requires licensed New York attorney review and written owner approval before publication or use. This draft does not amend existing customer agreements. Effective date: **not assigned**.
>
> Proposed contracting party: **[VERIFIED LLC LEGAL NAME]**, doing business as Gold On The Spot only if that trade name is verified. Operating location: New York City. Legal notice address: **[VERIFIED BUSINESS MAILING ADDRESS]**. Website: https://goldonthespot.com. Existing published support contact: support@goldonthespot.com (owner must confirm monitoring). No license, insurance, registration, or corporate formation fact is certified by this draft.

## Six distinct stages
1. **Displayed spot reference:** indicative market information, not an executable offer or the final merchandise price. Dealer adjustments, premiums, taxes and shipping may differ from the reference.
2. **Temporary checkout quote:** a server-created, account-bound quote for specified goods, quantities, method and total. It expires ten minutes after server creation. A browser countdown cannot extend it. Creating a quote does not create an order or reserve a perpetual price.
3. **Submitted order:** your affirmative submission before quote expiration offers to buy the identified goods on the displayed terms. The receipt must identify its offer-expiry time. Proposed offer window: until the quoted ten-minute expiry; a later acceptance requires a new quote and new assent. You may withdraw an unaccepted offer through the order portal or support, subject to recording which event occurred first. No market-loss charge applies to a withdrawn, expired or rejected unaccepted offer.
4. **Company acceptance:** the Company issues a definitive notice titled “Order accepted — binding purchase agreement,” records its issuance, and makes it available in your account. The notice identifies the order, goods, quantity, total, agreement versions and payment deadline. It must match your still-open offer. A modified price or material term is a counteroffer requiring your new assent, not an acceptance.
5. **Binding purchase agreement:** acceptance binds both parties to the confirmed price and terms. Market movements alone do not entitle either party to cancel. This stage is distinct from payment clearance.
6. **Paid and verified order:** trusted payment confirmation and required review permit fulfillment. A payment screen, bank screenshot or submitted wire advice is not proof of cleared payment. Fraud review approval is not itself contractual acceptance.

## Price and payment
The server validates product availability, quantities, premiums, taxes, discounts, shipping and any permitted method charge. You cannot select a binding price by editing a request or browser state. Review the final itemized total and destination before submission. If a quote expires or changes, review and affirmatively accept a new one. A duplicate request must retrieve the same order, not create another obligation. No order may be accepted where applicable tax treatment or a permitted charge remains unresolved.

Only methods displayed as enabled are available. Cards and wires are proposed launch methods; cryptocurrency has a separate dormant draft. Checks are not authorized. Card authorization may temporarily reserve funds; capture and acceptance are separate recorded events. If funds are captured before rejection, the Company must arrange the appropriate refund or release rather than treating payment as irrevocable acceptance. A later failed payment does not silently rewrite an accepted contract.

## Performance and default
You agree to pay the confirmed amount by the method and deadline stated in the acceptance. We agree to supply the conforming goods under the accepted shipping promise, subject to lawful exceptions. Inform us promptly of a genuine banking or payment problem. After appropriate review and notice, an uncured breach may permit lawful cancellation and documented damages under the Market Loss Policy. No charge arises solely because the market moved, because we rejected an offer, or because we cannot fulfill it.

## Rejection, errors and interruptions
Before acceptance we may reject an order for inventory, pricing error, verification, sanctions, technical or payment reasons, subject to nondiscrimination and consumer law. After acceptance, an error or supplier issue does not confer an unlimited cancellation right. We will assess a legally valid basis, communicate the issue, and seek a consensual correction or provide the remedy required by law. We will not substitute goods without approval or cancel solely to obtain a better market price.

Genuine events outside reasonable control may delay performance only to the extent legally excused. We must reasonably mitigate, notify you, provide a revised shipping date where required, and obtain required delay consent or refund. Routine price changes or foreseeable supplier difficulties are not automatically force majeure. We may not keep funds indefinitely.

## Assent and records
The unchecked checkout acknowledgment identifies the linked documents, version and binding-order effect. Wire customers additionally acknowledge the disclosed deadline rule and its computed date. An acceptance record preserves your account, order, quote snapshot, exact presented text, version hashes, server time, payment method and deadline. The Company separately records acceptance issuance. Records are retrievable on request with identity verification. New terms do not apply to a prior accepted order without a legally valid, separately documented agreement.

Applicable refund rights, payment disputes, lawful defenses and mandatory consumer remedies remain available. You may ask for an itemized explanation of any disputed charge through support.

## Scope and status
This proposed notice describes the reviewed website architecture and intended practices. Before publication the Company must verify its entity name, complete its vendor inventory and implement the retention and request procedures described below. It is not a claim that unverified controls or certifications already exist.

## Information we process
We process contact and account information such as names, email addresses and phone numbers; authentication and verification records; shipping and billing details; purchased products, prices, payment status and processor references; support messages, selling inquiries and photographs; and technical information such as IP-derived security information, device and browser information, page activity, referrers and approximate geography. Password authentication is handled through the authentication service; staff should not request passwords or full OTP values. Card entry is handled through Stripe’s payment components. The site stores payment metadata and references, not an intended copy of complete card credentials. Independent processor records are governed by the processor’s notice as well as applicable law.

Additional identity documentation may be requested for a specific lawful verification need. We do not routinely require government identification from every purchaser. Before collecting documents we will explain the purpose, provide a secure submission method, restrict access and establish retention. Do not upload identification, financial account credentials or unrelated people’s personal information to general support or selling photographs.

## Purposes and recipients
We use information to authenticate accounts, prepare and fulfill orders, communicate about payments and shipping, prevent fraud, secure the service, resolve requests and disputes, comply with law, maintain records and understand first-party site performance. Optional marketing requires separate choices and is not a condition of purchase.

The reviewed integrations include Supabase for authentication, database and private storage; Vercel for hosting and request handling; Stripe for card processing and payment risk controls; Bird/MessageBird and carriers for verification SMS; Resend for order and support email; and Cloudflare for the optional website assistant. Shipping carriers, any verified insurer, professional advisers and approved verification providers receive information necessary for their work. The precise carriers, insurers and any additional vendors must be confirmed before publication. We may disclose information pursuant to lawful process, to investigate fraud and protect rights, or in a business transfer subject to applicable safeguards. Payment and other providers may independently use data to meet their own legal obligations.

## Analytics and assistant
First-party analytics uses browser identifiers and sends activity to our server. The reviewed implementation observes Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track by disabling those analytics and provides a browser opt-out. That control does not prevent essential security or order processing. No advertising-pixel inventory has been certified by this draft. We do not claim that information is never disclosed, or that every disclosure is exempt from statutory “sale” or “sharing” definitions; counsel must classify the actual vendor arrangements.

If you use the optional assistant, your message and recent conversation context may be sent to Cloudflare to generate an answer. Do not include secrets or sensitive documents. The assistant can make errors and cannot approve contractual changes, refunds or account decisions. Use human support for those matters.

## Retention and security
We retain information as reasonably necessary for the identified purposes, applicable law, unresolved transactions, fraud investigations, disputes and legal holds. A request to delete an account does not immediately erase all transaction or legal records. Access restrictions, private storage and server checks are part of the reviewed architecture, but no service can promise absolute security. We will investigate suspected incidents and provide legally required notices. Specific retention periods and backup expiry will be documented internally and verified before this notice takes effect.

## Requests and choices
Contact support@goldonthespot.com with “Privacy request,” or use the approved account request channel when available. Describe whether you seek access, correction, deletion, a copy, an opt-out or an appeal; do not include a password or code. We will reasonably verify identity and authority proportionately to the request without collecting unnecessary identification. Where applicable, an authorized agent may act with proof of authority. We will respond within the applicable legal period and explain lawful limitations, extensions and available appeal procedures. We will not unlawfully discriminate for exercising privacy rights. State rights and applicability vary; the Privacy Rights Notice supplements this policy.

The service is for adults and is not directed to children under 13. Notify us of suspected child data so we can investigate and take appropriate action. United States operations do not mean every provider processes data only in the United States. Material practice changes require updated notice and any legally required consent; new notice does not authorize incompatible retroactive uses.

# Refund, Return and Cancellation Policy

## Conspicuous restriction on discretionary cancellations
**After definitive Company acceptance, bullion purchases are not ordinarily cancelable or returnable for buyer’s remorse, market movements, finding a lower price or changed investment preferences.** The restriction does not apply merely because you opened a quote or received a submission receipt. You may withdraw an unaccepted offer before acceptance. Do not assume a support request has canceled an already accepted order; request written confirmation.

## Rights that remain
This policy preserves applicable remedies for non-delivery, incorrect merchandise, materially inaccurate purity, weight or description, counterfeit products, misrepresentation, seller breach, unauthorized payments and other legally required refunds. It does not waive statutory warranties or card-dispute rights. If we cannot fulfill an accepted order, we will provide the legally required remedy rather than impose a cancellation fee on you.

## Reporting a problem
Contact support with your order number and a description. We prefer notice of visible shipping or merchandise problems within 48 hours of receipt so evidence can be preserved. **This is a preferred reporting period, not a forfeiture of rights after 48 hours.** Preserve packaging and available photographs; do not endanger yourself, disclose sensitive information publicly, or alter the metal while a claim is assessed. A failure to make an unboxing video does not by itself defeat a claim.

## Returns and remedies
Request return instructions before sending valuable goods. We will specify a secure return destination and appropriate shipping method. For substantiated seller error or defective/nonconforming goods we will bear reasonable authorized return costs to the extent required by law and provide the applicable repair, replacement, refund or other remedy. We will not insist on an unwanted substitute where you are legally entitled to a refund. A return inspection must be prompt and must not be used to postpone a mandatory refund unlawfully.

## Refund amounts and timing
Approved refunds normally go to the original method, subject to lawful verification and processor constraints. We will explain the amount and expected processing time and initiate refunds within the applicable legal deadline. Bank posting time is separate from initiation. A mandatory refund will not be reduced by an unsupported processing, restocking or market-loss fee. We will correct applicable tax and shipping amounts as law requires. No new discretionary restocking fee is proposed for launch.

A discretionary release from an accepted contract may involve separately explained, legally recoverable default damages under the Market Loss Policy; it is not permission to deduct an arbitrary amount from funds we hold. We will itemize any proposed offset, assess its legal basis and allow review. No default authorizes confiscation of the entire payment. A chargeback does not automatically establish customer fraud, and a refund does not authorize duplicate recovery. Disputed provider transactions will be reconciled so neither party receives an improper double payment.

# Market Loss and Price Lock Policy

> **DRAFT — NOT EFFECTIVE. Prepared October 23, 2026. Version 2026-10-23-draft.1.**

> Proposed contracting party: **[VERIFIED LLC LEGAL NAME]**, doing business as Gold On The Spot only if that trade name is verified. Operating location: New York City. Legal notice address: **[VERIFIED BUSINESS MAILING ADDRESS]**. Website: https://goldonthespot.com. Existing published support contact: support@goldonthespot.com (owner must confirm monitoring). No license, insurance, registration, or corporate formation fact is certified by this draft.

## Quote versus contract
A displayed market reference is indicative. A temporary server quote lasts ten minutes and applies only to its identified account, products, quantities, destination and payment method. It cannot be transferred, extended by browser changes or reused for another order. Submission alone does not make the purchase binding. Only definitive Company acceptance of a still-open offer creates the mutual price obligation described in the Purchase Agreement.

## When damages may arise
If you breach an accepted agreement without a lawful excuse, we may seek losses caused by that breach that applicable law and the agreement permit. We must establish the contract, breach, causal loss and a valid measure of damages; review any defenses; avoid unnecessary loss; and credit amounts saved or recovered. Ordinary market movement before acceptance creates no default claim. We cannot charge a loss caused by our own inability to supply, unjustified rejection or delayed mitigation.

## Calculation and review
A commercially reasonable resale measure ordinarily compares the accepted merchandise price for the affected quantity with the documented resale proceeds, adds recoverable incidental expenses and subtracts saved expenses and applicable credits. The legal suitability, timing, notice and allocation of that resale must be reviewed. If a different statutory measure is necessary, counsel must select it and identify the relevant market, time and place. A percentage change in spot alone is not the bill.

Documented hedging or administrative expenditures are considered only if caused by the breach, reasonably incurred and independently recoverable; they must not duplicate a price differential or ordinary overhead already included. Collection costs and attorneys’ fees are not automatic: recovery requires an applicable legal basis and appropriate approval or award. No fixed or percentage default fee is adopted by this draft. A future liquidated-damages proposal requires a separate reasonableness analysis and assent; it cannot be added to an old order retroactively.

## Illustrative example — not an automatic formula
Suppose an accepted merchandise price is $20,000. After an actionable customer default, a properly documented, commercially reasonable resale produces $19,400. Assume $80 of allowable incremental expense and $30 of costs avoided, with no other applicable credit. The candidate loss is $650 ($20,000 − $19,400 + $80 − $30). It remains subject to legal review of causation, mitigation, notice, evidence and offsets. A $1,000 payment already held is not automatically forfeited; any lawful $650 offset would leave $350 to return, subject to the actual legal restitution analysis. If the comparable resale instead produces $20,100, there is no $600 price-difference loss to invoice. Any remaining claimed expense must be separately justified and cannot create double recovery.

A defaulting purchaser does not automatically receive a speculative market gain or a right to direct the Company’s inventory resale. This does not eliminate mandatory restitution, required credits or an accounting for customer funds. We do not promise a positive resale return.

## Notice and dispute process
We will provide a written explanation identifying the accepted order, default, mitigation action, reference prices or resale evidence, recoverable expenses, credits and claimed amount. Confidential counterparty data may be appropriately redacted without hiding the basis of the calculation. You may challenge the facts or calculation through support and request human review. We will not automatically debit a bank account or charge a saved card for alleged damages. Any later payment authorization must independently satisfy law and processor rules. Reasonable dispute handling must not become intimidation or restrict lawful regulatory, payment or court remedies.

## Proposed deadline — not active
The proposed deadline is receipt of cleared USD funds by **5:00 PM America/New_York on the second business day after definitive Company acceptance**. The acceptance day is not counted. A business day is Monday through Friday excluding holidays on the disclosed receiving-bank/Fedwire operating calendar. The order must show the actual date, Eastern Time designation and time before you become bound. The server must use the approved calendar, including relevant closures; the example rule is not merely 48 elapsed hours. If an anticipated acceptance date changes the previously displayed deadline, your new acknowledgment must be obtained before acceptance.

The owner, receiving bank and attorney must approve this cutoff and calendar. Until approved and implemented, this draft changes no existing deadline. The Company must issue acceptance within the open offer window; prolonged review requires a renewed quote and assent.

## Sending payment safely
Use the beneficiary and bank details in the signed-in order record after acceptance and the corresponding authenticated notice. Include the exact order reference. Do not send funds to a changed destination based solely on an email, text, assistant response or unsolicited call. Stop and verify conflicting instructions through the known website contact, using a channel independent of the suspicious message. The Company will not announce a bank-account change by an unverified message alone.

A domestic USD wire ordinarily uses the bank’s approved domestic routing instructions. Use SWIFT or intermediary details only if the receiving bank actually requires and has approved them. No bank number or beneficiary is supplied by this draft. The account must belong to an approved beneficiary consistent with the contracting entity. Bank data must not be public website content or exposed to another customer.

## Amount, timing and verification
Arrange for the full confirmed amount to arrive, accounting for your bank’s cutoff and charges. A submitted transfer confirmation is not cleared funds. Tell us promptly about a genuine delay and provide a reference through support; do not send a duplicate wire while the first is being traced. We will assess banking disruptions reasonably and may document an extension without changing the agreed merchandise price. A bank processing delay is not automatically fraud or intentional misconduct.

Partial payment does not authorize partial shipment or amend the agreement. We will identify an underpayment and request an agreed resolution. Overpayments are reconciled and, where return is required, returned through a verified lawful channel; they are not a gratuity. Third-party payments require advance review and may be refused. We may investigate mismatched names, recalled transfers or suspicious confirmations, but will explain the disposition as law permits.

## Late payment and default
Contact us before sending after the deadline or cancellation. A late payment does not automatically revive a canceled order or create a new price lock. We will reconcile it and either agree a lawful resolution or return the amount due, subject to sanctions or other legal restraints. We will not keep late funds indefinitely. Before claiming default loss, we will establish acceptance, the disclosed deadline, nonperformance and any appropriate extension or excuse, and follow the Market Loss Policy. No automatic fixed fee, forfeiture or stored-card charge is authorized.

Fulfillment requires verified funds, acceptance and required security checks. We will not let an unexplained review hold displace applicable shipping, delay-consent or refund obligations.

## Authorized payment and itemized total
Use only a card you are authorized to use. The final total must be calculated by the server and displayed before authorization. Stripe processes card entry and may require authentication or additional checks. Do not send full card numbers or security codes to our support staff. A failed attempt must not create duplicate obligations; contact support if an attempt appears uncertain before paying again.

## Authorization, capture, acceptance and fulfillment
An authorization is a temporary issuer hold, not settlement or Company acceptance. Capture requests payment; settlement and fraud review are separate processes. The Company’s definitive acceptance notice creates the contract as described in the Purchase Agreement. A browser success page is not proof that payment succeeded. Fulfillment requires authenticated server confirmation of the correct order, currency and amount, contractual acceptance and required review.

If an offer is rejected, we will release an authorization or initiate the appropriate refund for captured funds. Reversals, disputes and partial or full refunds must remain visible in your order history even if a package was previously delivered. A payment dispute does not erase the shipment history, and shipment does not erase the refund history.

## Surcharges — release blocker
No new surcharge is authorized by this draft. Before any revised card pricing is published, the Company must obtain processor approval and comply with applicable state and network rules, including total-price disclosures, caps, receipt treatment and restrictions for debit and prepaid cards. A generic card fee cannot be assumed permissible for debit cards. The presently configured 4% fee must be resolved before launch; this draft does not validate it or silently amend an existing order. Counsel and the processor must approve either compliant method-specific handling or a pricing approach that avoids a surcharge. Calling an added fee a “discount” does not by itself make it compliant.

## Disputes and refunds
You retain statutory and network rights to dispute unauthorized, undelivered, incorrect or otherwise qualifying transactions. Contacting us can help resolve an issue but is not a prerequisite where law or issuer rules allow direct action. We may submit accurate order, assent, payment and delivery records in response to a dispute. We will not misrepresent a legitimate dispute as fraud or impose an automatic chargeback penalty. Refunds are ordinarily made to the original method under the Refund Policy. We will reconcile refunds and disputes to prevent duplicate recovery, without withholding a lawful refund merely because processor fees are nonrefundable to us.

This agreement does not authorize a later off-session card charge for market loss, collection fees or other alleged damages. Such payment would require a separate legally sufficient authorization and processor permission.

# Cryptocurrency Payment Terms — Dormant Draft

Legal notice address: **[VERIFIED BUSINESS MAILING ADDRESS]**. Website: https://goldonthespot.com. Existing published support contact: support@goldonthespot.com (owner must confirm monitoring). No license, insurance, registration, or corporate formation fact is certified by this draft.

## Not available at launch under the reviewed configuration
Cryptocurrency is disabled in the reviewed payment configuration. This document is a preparation draft, not an offer to accept cryptocurrency or an instruction to send it. No tokens, networks, wallet addresses or confirmation counts are approved here. Do not send cryptocurrency through support, social messages or an unsolicited address.

## Preconditions to activation
Before activation, the Company must identify and approve its processor, supported tokens and exact networks, settlement currency, screening procedures, confirmation policy, quote duration, underpayment tolerance, wrong-network recovery process, refund method and any fees. These details must be displayed before assent, reflected in the server invoice and tested in an isolated environment. Counsel must assess sanctions, money-transmission and New York licensing issues in light of actual activity; merchant payment acceptance does not authorize exchange, custody or transmission services.

## Proposed transaction rules
Only the exact token, network, destination and amount on a current server-issued invoice may be used. Blockchain transaction submission is not settlement; the processor’s authenticated confirmation and amount matching govern payment verification. Network congestion can delay confirmation. An expired invoice cannot be revived by changing a browser clock. An order may be accepted only under the Purchase Agreement; funds received on an expired or rejected order require reconciliation rather than automatic fulfillment at an old price.

Underpayments do not authorize shipment. Overpayments and duplicate payments require reconciliation and return where required. We will provide a controlled resolution process for a payment received after expiry. Wrong-token or wrong-network transfers may be technically unrecoverable, but we will not promise recovery or automatically retain recoverable value without a lawful basis. Any optional recovery service and actual charge must be separately disclosed and agreed before work. No recovery fee may be deducted from a legally mandatory refund unless lawful.

## Proposed refund basis — requires approval
The proposed commercial basis is the accepted order’s USD amount refundable under the Refund Policy, with the refund token quantity calculated using the approved processor’s disclosed rate at refund execution. This may differ from the original token quantity. The final method, rate source and necessary destination verification must be disclosed before payment; it cannot be selected opportunistically after a dispute. Mandatory law may require a different result. Refunds must not be directed to an unrelated third-party wallet without lawful verification. A legally blocked transaction must be handled under sanctions requirements, not reflexively returned.
